title: Final Eigenvalues
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly list the eigenvalues of M^2 with their corresponding multiplicities.

title: Commutation Justification
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain that M^2 commutes with M_x, allowing for the selection of common eigenstates.

title: Eigenvalue Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the eigenvalues of M^2 from the eigenvalues of M_x using the relation M^2 = m(m + 1).

title: Multiplicity Count
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately count and state the multiplicities of each eigenvalue for M^2.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units of the eigenvalues are consistent with the physical context of the problem.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes when calculating eigenvalues from M_x.

title: Total Count Verification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should verify that the total number of eigenvalues sums to 256.
